nodes.name: Ti₃C₂Tₓ coating on CC
nodes.procedure: The carbon cloth (CeTech, WOS1009) was cleaned by acetone, alcohol and then cleaned by plasma cleaner for 8 min under vacuum to obtain a hydrophilic surface. Subsequently, carbon cloth was soaked in Ti₃C₂Tₓ ink (~7.8 mg mL⁻¹) for 10 min and dried at 50 °C. Then as-prepared samples were annealed in N₂ atmosphere at 350 °C for 3 h in order to ensure a close adherence of Ti₃C₂Tₓ on carbon cloth (Ti₃C₂Tₓ/CC).

nodes.name: Pristine NiCo-LDH electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: The Pt plate (1 × 1.5 cm²) was applied as the counter electrode, the Ag/AgCl/3 M KCl was used as the reference electrode and the carbon cloth with the area of 1 × 1.5 cm² immersed in the electrolyte was used as the working electrode. The electrolyte was composed of 10×10⁻³ M Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, 5×10⁻³ M Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O and 20×10⁻³ M NaNO₃. Initially, 0 V was applied for 20 s and then -1.4 V was kept for 800 s. After the deposition process, the carbon cloth coated with NiCo-LDH was washed with deionized water and ethanol three times each before drying at 50 °C overnight. Samples prepared without applying magnetic field were denoted as the pristine NiCo-LDH.

nodes.description: Three-electrode supercapacitor testing of various NiCo-LDH samples (pristine and under different HMFs) in 1 M KOH at 1 mA/cm²
nodes.source_text: Owing to the highest loading mass and abundant exposure of active sites, NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) presents the best areal capacity of 2.73 C cm⁻² (normalized to 820 C g⁻¹), compared with 0.39 C cm⁻² (normalized to 534 C g⁻¹) for the pristine NiCo-LDH at the current density of 1 mA cm⁻²... the highest loading mass of 3.3 mg cm⁻² is achieved for NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) compared with 0.7 mg cm⁻² for the pristine NiCo-LDH.

nodes.description: Three-electrode supercapacitor testing of Ti3C2Tx/NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) vs NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) and pristine NiCo-LDH in 1 M KOH
nodes.source_text: Ti3C2Tx/NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) exhibits an outstanding areal capacitance of 3.12 C cm⁻² as well as normalized gravimetric capacity of 830 C g⁻¹... At the current density of 30 mA cm⁻², Ti3C2Tx/NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) still maintains 56.7% of the initial capacity... After 1500 charge–discharge cycles, 71.8% of the initial capacity was maintained.

nodes.description: All-solid-state flexible hybrid supercapacitor (HSC) device testing with Ti3C2Tx/NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E)//activated carbon
nodes.source_text: The single device delivers a maximum energy density of 0.134 mWh cm⁻² at the power density of 1.61 mW cm⁻²... After 6000 charge–discharge cycles, 82.3% of the initial areal capacitance is maintained... 65.3% of the total areal capacitance is surface-controlled at the scan rate of 10 mV s⁻¹... 55.7% of the initial capacitance is preserved as the current density increases from 2 to 50 mA cm⁻².

nodes.characterization_summary: Top-view SEM shows pristine NiCo-LDH nanosheets randomly arranged while NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) shows upright nest-like porous structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the top-view scanning electron microscopy (SEM) image in Figure 1b, nanosheets of the pristine NiCo-LDH arrange randomly with fractional nanosheets lying on the CC. Differently... presenting a unique nest-like porous structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns show diffraction peaks of (003), (012), and (110) confirming successful preparation of NiCo-LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD patterns of different samples are demonstrated in Figure S3d,e... Diffraction peaks of (003), (012), and (110) are clearly labeled, suggesting the successful preparation of NiCo-LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows NiCo-LDH nanosheets cross-linked forming 3D structure; elemental mappings indicate uniform distribution of Ni, Co, and O.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM image of NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) is displayed in Figure 2c. NiCo-LDH nanosheets are cross-linked together... Elemental mappings (Figure S5d, Supporting Information) indicate a uniform distribution of Ni, Co, and O.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM of NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) shows clear lattice fringes with d-spacings of 0.15 nm (110) and 0.26 nm (012).
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRTEM image in Figure 2d shows clear lattice fringes, indicating a good crystallinity of sample. The marked d-spacing of 0.15 and 0.26 nm can be well indexed to the (110) and (012) plane of NiCo-LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern verifies the lattice planes of NiCo-LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: which is further verified by the selected area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern (Figure 2e).

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman spectrum suggests presence of NO3- as intercalated anions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectrum of NiCo-LDH-3 T (B//E) is demonstrated in Figure S6... suggesting the presence of NO3- as intercalated anions.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS of fresh Ti3C2Tx flakes shows rich functional surface groups -OH, -O, and -F.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The composition and surface chemistry of fresh Ti3C2Tx flakes were investigated by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) as shown in Figure S14a–d... suggesting rich functional surface groups such as –OH, –O, and –F.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM of Ti3C2Tx/NiCo-LDH shows (002) plane of MXene d-spacing 1.28 nm and (003) plane of NiCo-LDH d-spacing 0.76 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HRTEM image of composite is provided in Figure S14g (Supporting Information). The (002) plane of MXene with the d-spacing of 1.28 nm and the (003) plane of NiCo-LDH with the d-spacing of 0.76 nm are labeled.

nodes.characterization_summary: FTIR shows pronounced peak at 1384 cm^-1 corresponding to NO3- stretching vibration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 4h demonstrates the Fourier Transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR)... Notably, there is a pronounced peak at 1384 cm^-1, corresponding to the NO3- stretching vibration.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution Ni 2p XPS shows Ni2+ at 855.3 and 872.9 eV, Ni3+ at 856.6 and 874.9 eV; Co 2p shows Co3+ at 781.1 and 796.7 eV, Co2+ at 782.3 and 797.8 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution Ni 2p spectrum can be deconvoluted into four main peaks... Two peaks located at 855.3 and 872.9 eV are assigned to Ni2+, and another two peaks located at 856.6 and 874.9 eV correspond to Ni3+. For the high-resolution Co 2p spectrum... Peaks centered at 781.1 and 796.7 eV are attributed to Co3+, while peaks with the binding energy of 782.3 and 797.8 eV are originated from Co2+.
